arxiv-2201-01052.title: Representation theory via cohomology of line bundles
arxiv-2201-01052.creator: Henning Haahr Andersen
arxiv-2201-01052.description: Abstract . Let G G be a reductive algebraic group over a field k k and let B B be a Borel subgroup in G G . We demonstrate how a number of results on the cohomology of line bundles on the flag manifold G / B G/B have had interesting consequences in the representation theory for G G .

arxiv-2211-06995.title: Adaptive Learning-Based Detection for One-Bit Quantized Massive MIMO Systems
arxiv-2211-06995.creator: Yunseong Cho, Jinseok Choi, Brian L. Evans, Dept. of Electrical Engineering, Ulsan National Institute of Science, TechnologyEmail: jinseokchoi@unist.ac.kr
arxiv-2211-06995.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yunseong Cho, Jinseok Choi, Brian L. Evans, Dept. of Electrical Engineering, Ulsan National Institute of Science, TechnologyEmail: jinseokchoi@unist.ac.kr. We propose an adaptive learning-based framework for uplink massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems with one-bit analog-to-digital converters. Learning-based detection does not need to estimate channels, which overcomes a key drawback in one-bit quantized systems. During training, learning-based detection suffers at high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) because observations will be biased to + 1 +1 or − 1 -1 which leads to many zero-valued empirical likelihood functions.

arxiv-2303-13979.title: Exclusive diffractive bremsstrahlung of one and two photons at forward rapidities: possibilities for experimental studies in 𝒑 ​ 𝒑 pp collisions at the LHC
arxiv-2303-13979.creator: Piotr Lebiedowicz, Otto Nachtmann, Antoni Szczurek
arxiv-2303-13979.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Piotr Lebiedowicz, Otto Nachtmann, Antoni Szczurek. We evaluate the cross section for diffractive bremsstrahlung of a single photon in the p ​ p → p ​ p ​ γ pp\to pp\gamma reaction at high energies and at forward photon rapidities. Several differential distributions, for instance, in y {\rm y} , k ⟂ k_{\perp} and ω \omega , the rapidity, the absolute value of the transverse momentum, and the energy of the photon, respectively, are presented.

arxiv-2505-08856.title: Expanding Ejecta Method: II. Framework for Cosmological Distance Measurements via Intensity Interferometry
arxiv-2505-08856.creator: David Dunsky, I-Kai Chen, Junwu Huang, Ken Van Tilburg, Robert V. Wagoner
arxiv-2505-08856.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Dunsky, I-Kai Chen, Junwu Huang, Ken Van Tilburg, Robert V. Wagoner. We explore the potential of the expanding ejecta method (EEM) Chen et al. 2025 as a cosmological probe, leveraging its ability to measure angular diameter distances to supernovae (SNe) with intensity interferometry.

arxiv-2507-20643.title: Ontology-Enhanced Knowledge Graph Completion using Large Language Models
arxiv-2507-20643.creator: Wenbin Guo, Xin Wang, Jiaoyan Chen, Zhao Li, Zirui Chen
arxiv-2507-20643.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have been extensively adopted in Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC), showcasing significant research advancements. However, as black-box models driven by deep neural architectures, current LLM-based KGC methods rely on implicit knowledge representation with parallel propagation of erroneous knowledge, thereby hindering their ability to produce conclusive and decisive reasoning outcomes.

arxiv-2511-10469.title: Connecting conformal dimension and Poincaré profiles
arxiv-2511-10469.creator: David Hume, John M. Mackay
arxiv-2511-10469.description: Abstract . We strengthen the connection between the Ahlfors-regular (AR) conformal dimension Confdim ⁡ ( Z ) \Confdim(Z) of a compact AR metric space Z Z and a certain critical exponent of the Poincaré profiles p Λ p_{\Lambda} of its hyperbolic cone X X in the sense of Bonk–Schramm.

pmc-12568060.title: Workflow Analysis for CGH Generation with Speckle Reduction and Occlusion Culling Using GPU Acceleration
pmc-12568060.creator: Francisco J. Serón, Alfonso Blesa, Diego Sanz
pmc-12568060.description: Although GPUs are widely used in Computer-Generated Holography (CGH), their specific application to concrete problems such as occlusion or speckle filtering through temporal multiplexing is not yet standardized and has not been fully explored. This work aims to optimize the software architecture by taking the GPU architecture into account in a novel way for these particular tasks.

pmc-12975578.description: EGFRvIII is a tumor-specific, gain-of-function mutation of the EGFR gene that was first detected in 1990 in glioblastoma. pmc-13441562.description: PurposeChronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) is an inflammatory disease in which eosinophil (Eos) infiltration into polyp tissues is associated with disease prognosis.
